name: io.github.antideploy/antideploy-mcp
title: Antideploy
description: Deploy an app to Antideploy from a coding agent. No Dockerfile, no YAML, no cloud console.

environmentVariables.name: ANTIDEPLOY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Antideploy API key for the application, created in the console under the application's settings. Starts with ad_.

environmentVariables.name: ANTIDEPLOY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Antideploy instance. Defaults to https://antideploy.com. Only set for a self-hosted or staging instance.
